user.title: Connect Seamless
user.description: Sign in at seamless.com in a browser and copy the session's refresh token, client ID and device ID from the /auth/login response. Then close or clear that browser session so it doesn't rotate the same token. No password is needed or stored.

reauth_confirm.title: Seamless session expired
reauth_confirm.description: Seamless rejected the saved session. Sign in at seamless.com again, copy the new refresh token (the client ID and device ID stay the same), then clear that browser session.

abort.unique_id_mismatch: That is a different Seamless account. Sign in with the account this entry was set up with.
